id.title: Collector ID
id.description: The ID that identifies the collector

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of collector that's used to send the survey: 'Web Link' or 'Email'

status.title: Status
status.description: The status of the collector: 'Open' or 'Closed'

name.title: Nickname
name.description: The name that's given to the collector (the default is the type of collector)

thank_you_message.title: Thank You Message
thank_you_message.description: A message to show on the 'thank you' page (the default is 'Thank you for completing our survey!')

disqualification_message.title: Disqualification message
disqualification_message.description: A message to show on the disqualification page (the default is 'Thank you for completing our survey!')

close_date.title: Close date
close_date.description: The date when the collector will close

closed_page_message.title: Closed page message
closed_page_message.description: A message to show when a survey is closed (the default is 'Thank you for completing our survey!')

redirect_url.title: Redirection URL
redirect_url.description: A URL to redirect respondents when they complete the survey

display_survey_results.title: Display survey results
display_survey_results.description: Shows instant results for a survey when a respondent completes it (by default, instant results are not shown)

edit_response_type.title: Edit response type
edit_response_type.description: Indicates when respondents can edit their response: 'Until Complete', 'Never', or 'Always' (the default is 'Until Complete')

anonymous_type.title: Anonymous type
anonymous_type.description: Indicates whether respondents are anonymous by turning off IP tracking and, for Email collectors, removing the respondent's email address and name from the response; values are  'not_anonymous', 'partially_anonymous', or 'fully_anonymous' (the default is 'not_anonymous')

allow_multiple_responses.title: Allow multiple responses
allow_multiple_responses.description: Indicates whether respondents can complete a survey more than once from the same browser on the same computer (by default, they can't)

password.title: Password
password.description: The password that is required to access the survey

sender_email.title: Sender email
sender_email.description: The email address of the sender of the survey that respondents see for Email collectors

date_modified.title: Date modified
date_modified.description: The date when the collector was last updated

url.title: URL
url.description: The URL of the Web Link collector

date_created.title: Date created
date_created.description: The date when the collector was created

password_enabled.title: Password enabled
password_enabled.description: Indicates whether the collector is password protected
